english.title: Aggravated vehicle taking - ( initial taker ) death caused by accident
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the owner or other lawful authority, took a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), for the use of yourself or another and after the vehicle was unlawfully taken and before it was recovered, owing to the driving of the vehicle, an accident occurred by which the death of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was caused

(A)_[There were no other aggravating factors]_
(B)_[Additional aggravating factors were **(..SPECIFY FACTORS..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12A of the Theft Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without the consent of the owner/lawful authority took (being the initial taker)
a mechanically propelled vehicle for your own/anothers use
and after it was taken and before it was recovered
owing to the driving of the vehicle an accident occurred by which death was caused

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and offence wording is now OBSOLETE - penalty by s.285(1) CJA 2003. now see CJS Code TH68162 and H6004.

(i) This wording is for use ONLY were the defendant was the 'INITIAL TAKER' - for a 'subsequent driver' see H4385 and 'being carried on' see H4388.
(ii) See also H4383, H4391, H4384, H4480, H4481 and H4482 for other aggravated vehicle taking wordings relating to the 'initial taker'.
(iii) More than one deceased person may be named.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment.

Obligatory disqualification and endorsement.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to eleven penalty points - only if special reasons apply.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
